name: Little Message Lite
author: codigoed

sections.description:
Little Message Lite is a lightweight WordPress plugin that adds a floating button to your site. When clicked, it opens a compact contact form so visitors can send you a quick message via email — no page reloads required.

Messages are also stored in your WordPress database for easier access and backup.

Just set your email address, and you’re ready to go. Ideal for portfolios, simple sites, landing pages, or anyone who needs a fast and clean way to receive messages.

Includes optional reCAPTCHA v2 or v3 to prevent spam, plus customizable design and display options.

Upgrade to PRO to reply to messages from your WordPress admin, unlock advanced display rules, and add more contact methods like Telegram or Messenger.

Upgrade to PRO

  • Reply to messages from the WordPress admin
  • Customize where and when the button appears

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/little-message-lite
  2. Activate it via the WordPress “Plugins” menu.
  3. Configure your email, reCAPTCHA keys, and design options under Little Message Lite settings.
  4. Done! You’ll start receiving messages from your visitors.
sections.faq:
Where does the floating button appear?

By default, only on the homepage (is_front_page()), usually at the bottom right corner.

Are messages saved in WordPress?

Yes. Messages submitted through the form are stored in your WordPress database in a custom table, so you can keep a backup even if the email fails.

Does it support multiple email recipients?

Not in the Lite version. You can only set one email address. Multiple recipients are available in the PRO version.

How do I enable anti-spam?

Enter your reCAPTCHA v2 or v3 keys in the plugin settings to protect the form from bots.

Can I customize the look?

Yes, you can upload a logo, change the welcome message, and adjust the position of the floating button.

Does this plugin use third-party services?

Yes, optional anti-spam protection is provided via Google reCAPTCHA.
Use of this feature is subject to Google’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
